text: The cheese is not made differently from other semi-hard cheeses; it is ripened in a sealed pit, and the pit itself is part of the recipe.

steps.note: Matured 20-30 days before burying, though the PDO rules are reported as at least 80 days.

steps.name: prepare pit
steps.note: Straw is burned in it to dry and sanitise it, then it is lined with straw, reeds and planks.

steps.name: bag
steps.note: White cotton or linen bags, about ten wheels each.

steps.name: bury
steps.note: In mid-to-late August, sealed with plaster, wood and sand.
Without air the fermentation is anaerobic, and the cheese softens and loses lactose, water and fat.

steps.name: unearth
steps.note: On St Catherine (25 Nov) in Sogliano, St Martin (11 Nov) in Perticara.
